name: Backtracking Space Leap Rays
aliases: Backtracking Correction for Space Leap Rays
definition: A correction step applied to space leap rays to ensure they do not miss non-transparent sample points inside a cell group by ensuring the first sample of the ray is always in an empty cell.
summary: Backtracking Space Leap Rays is a volume rendering correction that prevents missed data by verifying leap targets and moving the ray origin backward if it lands in a non-empty cell.
